infeasible.reason: After careful analysis of all four partners' calendars, there is no 30-minute slot next week (Mon Nov 16 - Fri Nov 20, 9:00-17:00) where all four partners (Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor) are simultaneously available.
